name: Blow a Kiss
flavor: Pucker up. It's the last free thing you get tonight.

name: Lipstick Jab
flavor: Leaves a mark. Usually a red one.

name: Switchblade Hook
flavor: Fast, thin, and gone before you feel it.

name: Rhinestone Cross
flavor: Sequins are a girl's best friend. Ask your eyebrow.

name: Encore
text: Deal 2 damage for each card in the chain.
flavor: The crowd wanted more. So did she.

name: Peek-a-Boo
flavor: Hands up, eyes open, smile on.

name: Lipstick Jab+
flavor: Fresh coat. Same bad news.

name: Switchblade Hook+
flavor: Sharper on the second pass.

name: Rhinestone Cross+
flavor: More sparkle. More stitches.

name: Encore+
text: Deal 3 damage for each card in the chain.
flavor: By popular demand.

name: Peek-a-Boo+
flavor: Now you see her. Now you're on the canvas.

name: Cherry Feint
flavor: She telegraphs the left. On purpose.

name: Rat-a-Tat
flavor: Three to the jaw and a wink for the cheap seats.

name: Bob & Weave
text: Any card can link after this one.
flavor: You can't hit a girl who's already somewhere else.

name: Curtain Call
flavor: Take a bow, darling. Someone will help you up.

name: Standing Ovation
text: Deal 3 damage for each card in the chain.
flavor: The whole house is on its feet. Except you.

name: Touch Gloves
flavor: Manners first. It makes the rest so much more personal.

name: Velvet Jab
flavor: Soft on the outside.

name: Liver Shot
flavor: Somewhere south of the ribs, a whole evening ends.

name: High Guard
flavor: Elbows in, chin down, one eyebrow up.

name: Last Call
flavor: Bar's closed, sugar. Somebody get her a cab.

name: Smoke Break
flavor: One drag, one breath, one long look at the damage.

name: Velvet Jab+
flavor: Plusher glove. Same brick inside.

name: Liver Shot+
flavor: She found the spot. She'll find it again.

name: High Guard+
flavor: Higher, tighter, ruder.

name: Last Call+
flavor: Closing time comes early.

name: Cover Up
flavor: Go ahead, swing. I bill by the hit.

name: Shoulder Bump
flavor: Excuse me. I said excuse me.

name: Lean on the Ropes
text: Any card can link after this one.
flavor: Let her punch herself out. Then dance.

name: Ten Count
flavor: She's never needed to count past ten.

name: Bouncer's Guard
flavor: You're not on the list, honey.

name: Second Wind
flavor: Smelling salts and spite.

name: Strike a Pose
flavor: One for the cameras. One for her.

name: Haymaker
flavor: No subtlety. No refunds.

name: Rushdown
flavor: Corner her. Keep her there.
